papers.title: Integrated Experimental and Computational Analysis of SLM-Fabricated Ti6Al4V Octet-Truss Scaffolds for Bone Tissue Engineering
papers.abstract: This study investigates the fabrication, characterization, and computational analysis of a Ti6Al4V porous scaffold for bone tissue engineering (BTE). The main objective is to address the stress-shielding effect caused by the mismatch in the mechanical properties between the scaffold and surrounding bone. An octet-truss architecture was considered to design a highly porous scaffold (with 80.5% porosity) and fabricated using selective laser melting (SLM). The scaffold was then treated with post-processing chemical etching in oxalic acid to remove surface defects and tailor topography. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) revealed that etching effectively removed adhered unmelted powder particles and created a distinct micro-textured strut surface (with increased roughness) that is conducive to osseointegration. The etching process also uniformly thinned down the struts and resulted in 10% mass loss. A compression test gave the scaffold’s compliance-corrected elastic moduli of 4.54 ± 0.18 GPa (pre-etching) and 3.53 ± 0.06 GPa (post-etching). These values closely match with the stiffness of human trabecular bone reported in the literature. The experimental modulus results were validated with a finite element model that predicted 4.188 GPa, which agrees well with the experiment. Furthermore, computational fluid dynamic simulations evaluated a permeability of 8 × 10–9 m2, consistent with transport in bone-like structures.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是用于骨组织工程的Ti6Al4V八面体桁架支架，并非针对股骨柄植入物设计，因此与用户关注的方向不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on a generic octet-truss scaffold for bone tissue engineering, not a femoral/hip stem implant; it lacks any stem-specific design, fatigue testing, or stress shielding analysis for a femoral stem.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决骨组织工程中支架与骨骼力学性能不匹配导致的应力遮挡问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备Ti6Al4V八面体桁架多孔支架，并进行化学蚀刻后处理，结合实验与有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 支架弹性模量3.53–4.54 GPa，与人小梁骨匹配；蚀刻后表面粗糙度增加，利于骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和有限元模拟对弹性模量进行验证，实验与仿真结果吻合良好。

summary_en.motivation: To address stress shielding caused by mechanical mismatch between bone tissue engineering scaffolds and surrounding bone.
summary_en.method: An octet-truss Ti6Al4V scaffold with 80.5% porosity was fabricated by selective laser melting and post-processed with chemical etching in oxalic acid; experimental compression tests and finite element simulations were conducted.
summary_en.result: The scaffold exhibited elastic moduli of 3.53–4.54 GPa, matching human trabecular bone; etching increased surface roughness and removed unmelted particles, promoting osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression test data were validated by finite element analysis, showing good agreement; permeability was evaluated via CFD.

papers.title: Numerical investigation of microstructural elastic anisotropy effects on the fretting fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, KU Leuven, Ghent, Belgium

corresponding_authors.name: Reza Talemi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, KU Leuven, Ghent, Belgium

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的微结构弹性各向异性对微动疲劳性能的影响，完全符合方向1的疲劳与力学性能关注点。
llm.why_not_core: No experimental validation, purely numerical simulation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V微结构弹性各向异性如何影响微动疲劳性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用数值模拟方法，建立考虑晶粒取向的微结构模型分析微动疲劳行为。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了弹性各向异性对微动疲劳裂纹萌生和寿命的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与文献中已有实验数据或理论解对比验证模型准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To numerically investigate how microstructural elastic anisotropy affects the fretting fatigue performance of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: A numerical model incorporating crystallographic orientations was developed to simulate fretting fatigue behavior.
summary_en.result: The study quantified the influence of elastic anisotropy on fatigue crack initiation and life.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing simulation results with experimental data or analytical solutions from previous studies.

papers.title: Trinity coupling for microstructure regulation and pore healing in Ti-6Al-4V via press-enhanced local electropulsing treatment
papers.first_author_affiliation: Key Laboratory of Automobile Materials, Ministry of Education, and Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Jilin University, Changchun, People’s Republic of China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaofeng Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Automobile Materials, Ministry of Education, and Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Jilin University, Changchun, People’s Republic of China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注后处理工艺（电脉冲处理）对Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和孔隙的修复，而非L1层要求的原始状态或工艺状态的力学/疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on a post-processing treatment (electropulsing) for microstructure regulation and pore healing, which falls under Layer 2, not the as-built or process-state mechanical/fatigue characterization required for Layer 1.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过电脉冲处理改善Ti-6Al-4V微观结构并修复孔隙。
summary_zh.method: 采用压力辅助局部电脉冲处理（PLET）技术。
summary_zh.result: 实现了微观结构调控和孔隙愈合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和微观表征验证效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V by refining microstructure and healing internal pores through a novel electropulsing treatment.
summary_en.method: A press-enhanced local electropulsing treatment (PLET) was applied to as-built Ti-6Al-4V to induce rapid heating and plastic deformation.
summary_en.result: The treatment led to significant grain refinement, pore closure, and improved tensile properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and microstructural analysis (EBSD, SEM) were performed to characterize the changes.

key_terms.zh: 压力辅助局部电脉冲处理
